reason: Fixed in 14.0.2 only; js-beautify 2.0.3, its latest release, requires ^13.0.6, and is reached through @vue/test-utils. It runs in the Vitest suite alone, over the files of this repository: deploy.sh installs it on the server, but nothing in npm run build calls it, and nothing an attacker controls reaches it.

Fixed in 11.0.1 only; eslint 10.14.0, @eslint/config-array 0.23.5, editorconfig 3.0.2 and glob 13, all at their latest release, require ^10. It only matches patterns written in this repository (the ESLint configuration, .editorconfig): the flaw is a denial of service on a crafted pattern, and nobody else can hand it one. Not called by npm run build.
